scopes.description: Full supplied workflow: SAS builds firm-year and lawsuit data, pauses at the ar/Eventus handoff, continues the main outcome and connected-school branches after the CAR table is resolved, then stages same-name DTA handoffs and runs the Stata driver. The Eventus MM, FF and FFM branches are all retained.

requirements.description: The firm-year producer requires North American Compustat annual fundamentals with gvkey, datadate, fyear, identifiers, industry/location fields, and the financial inputs explicitly kept in the SAS source. It constructs lagged firm controls, so the source must extend at least one fiscal year before each target observation.

issues.description: The full supplied workflow consumes 43 requirement records representing 44 distinct input products (with D0041 and D0042 grouped as the two homogeneous GDP partitions); most custom author-prepared tables are absent from the imported archive, which contains a URL identifier list rather than analysis data. Local catalog candidates and official public documentation do not establish complete field, key, product or required-history compatibility. Keep each independent requirement separate and resolve specific input contracts without imposing original-byte or original-vintage gates.

SAS creates firm_year, outcome2024, judge_number_case and ar as in-memory tables that the Stata or CAR program reads as same-name DTA files. The data producers and consumer keys exist; explicit SAS7BDAT-to-DTA serialization and a consistent relative transfer directory are missing.

All MM, FF and FFM Eventus branches are present. The active FF branch produces event_CAR_FF and car_ff.dta; the separate FFM branch produces event_CAR_FFM and car_ffm.dta. Main SAS reads raw_data.event_CAR_FF, while Stata consumes car_n1p1_ffmvalue. The exact selected branch/table transfer and field mapping are unresolved; do not infer an alias or claim the FF producer is missing.

The CAR source runs Eventus inside a remote SAS/CONNECT flow and requests ff.factors_daily for FF/FFM. The compatible remote SAS/CONNECT engine, Eventus interface, authorized session setup, factor member schema and estimation-window history are not verified. Screened connection blocks remain opaque; no access denial or credential state is inferred from their omission.

review_notes: The target is the complete supplied workflow. The exact entry points are Final_Code_JAR.do, JAR_CODE.sas, and JAR_CODE_CAR.sas; no separate analysis-only scope is supported by the packaged URL identifier list.

The archive contains the datasheet, supplied Stata/SAS programs, appendix, logs, and Identifiers_URL.dta, but no full analysis dataset. The identifier probe establishes a readable URL list only. All three raw logs remain opaque.

The assessment records 43 separate data requirements, including the required ff.factors_daily input; D0041 and D0042 remain one requirement only because they are homogeneous state-GDP year partitions. All 50 frozen checklist IDs are reviewed, including seven generated/intermediate products with active producer evidence.

Catalog findings are bounded metadata candidates only. The Compustat, CRSP, IBES, BoardEx/WRDS, Audit Analytics, and RavenPack candidates do not establish complete product, field, key, population, or history compatibility. No requirement demands byte-identical author data or a download-date vintage where a compatible product and supported preparation suffice.

The registered original environment probe supports Stata 18, reghdfe 6.12.3, and ftools 2.49.1; winsor2 and outreg2 are unavailable. SAS, SAS/CONNECT, Eventus, and the remote factor member remain unverified. No software startup, install, author-code run, statistical/parser/model trial, or data/API/archive payload request was performed.

Same-table SAS-to-Stata preparation is supported for firm_year, outcome2024, and judge_number_case; the SAS ar table has compatible url, permno, and filing_date fields for the CAR import. Standard DTA conversion and shared-path setup are preparation steps. The separate FF and FFM branches and car_*.dta exports are preserved; the raw_data.event_CAR_FF to car_n1p1_ffmvalue schema/branch mapping remains unresolved.
